name: P-006 real-holder scorecard readback comparison controls
command: Compare the returned fields with the four deliberately false expectations and the four exact readback expectations in assertions below.
summary: The live comparison rejected four deliberately false reports and accepted four exact readbacks of the existing real-holder card. The historical card remains FAIL. Its earlier provisional card is not a second terminal grade. Historical residue has current terminal dispositions and a separately owned blocked successor. This comparison does not independently vet the revised rubric, repair the historical holder window, prove L3, or establish shipment.
comparisonLimit: These are live readback comparison controls. Negative controls change the expected report, not the historical scorecard or operator state. They establish detection of the named false readbacks; they do not establish a new real-world holder outcome.

assertions.evidence: Deliberately false PASS expectation was rejected: scorecards:get EI-24713330305263301 returned rollup.verdict=fail; the complete plan-fleet-materialization criterion read returned rating=fail and 0 of 1 eligible plan fleets materialized.

Exact readback accepted: rollup.verdict=fail, criticalFailures=[plan-fleet-materialization], criticalUnknowns=[goal-mode-foundation], criterion rating=fail, and selected criterion evidenceRead.complete=true.
Deliberately false fixture-card/pending-audit expectation was rejected: card id is EI-24713330305263301, synthesized=false, gradingAudit.state=passed, auditIssueId=EI-24713725963525495.

Exact existing-card readback accepted: audit item EI-24713725963525495 is done; auditor su-778c7ed9 differs from grader su-4f968faa. This is the historical rev7 audit; current revised rubric vetting remains separate.

Deliberately false fixture-subject/two-terminal-cards expectation was rejected: subject.kind=agent-run, and scorecards:list for this holder returned one terminal card EI-24713330305263301 plus one provisional card EI-24713260630186958 for the exact same window; hasMore=false.

Exact subject and history readback accepted: real holder su-af7cfbba during 16:54:04Z–18:29:52Z; one terminal independent card; earlier same-window card is explicitly provisional. No new card or fixture goal was created by this check.
Deliberately false all-done/unowned-successor report was rejected: WI-10003903 is dropped (not done) with terminalOwner su-f6e01d34; successor WI-10004612 is blocked and assigned to su-32d1b8df.

Exact current residue readback accepted: WI-10004329, EI-24556293106348130, WI-10004358 are done with terminalOwner su-4f968faa; WI-10003903 is dropped with terminalOwner su-f6e01d34; separately owned successor WI-10004612 remains blocked with assignee su-32d1b8df. Historical FAIL is unchanged.
